# Power Platform Daily

> A curated collection of Microsoft Power Platform product news: short, source-credited summaries of Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Microsoft Fabric updates with a direct link to the original article. Maintained by Marcel Lehmann, Microsoft MVP, from Switzerland.

Power Platform Daily brings useful product-news articles from different blogs into one place, so readers do not have to check a dozen feeds by hand for new features, releases and roadmap changes. Each curated entry offers a short TL;DR, a practical takeaway and full credit plus a direct link to the original source and author. Content is published bilingually in English and German.

Key facts for orientation:

- Site: Power Platform Daily (https://powerplatformdaily.com)
- Maintainer: Marcel Lehmann, Microsoft MVP (Switzerland)
- Content type: curated third-party summaries, not original reporting; every entry credits its source author, source site and original URL
- Language: English and German (bilingual, /en/ and /de/ paths)
- Topics: Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Microsoft Fabric - new features, releases, roadmap, integrations/connectors and practical how-to guidance
- Out of scope: governance, security, compliance, DLP, ALM, CoE and administration - that is covered by our sister site, Power Platform Governance
- Related brand: KMUpower (consulting, coaching, workshops) – https://kmupower.com
- Related brand: Power Platform Academy (live Power Platform workshops by Marcel Lehmann) – https://www.powerplatformacademy.online
- Related brand: PowerPlatformTip (field-tested Power Platform tips) – https://www.powerplatformtip.com
- Related brand: Power Platform Governance (governance, security and compliance curation, the sister site to this one) – https://powerplatformgovernance.com

## Main pages

- [About](https://powerplatformdaily.com/about/): What this site is, why it exists, and what it covers.
- [Sources](https://powerplatformdaily.com/sources/): The original blogs and authors behind the curated summaries, with credit and direct links.
- [Archives](https://powerplatformdaily.com/archives/): All curated posts by date.
- [Tags](https://powerplatformdaily.com/tags/): Browse curated summaries by topic.
- [Submit content](https://powerplatformdaily.com/submit/): Suggest a product-news blog or article for curation.

## Topics covered

- Copilot Studio: new features, agent capabilities, releases
- Power Apps: new features, controls, releases
- Power Automate: new actions, connectors, releases
- Power BI: new features, visuals, releases
- Microsoft Fabric: new capabilities, integrations, releases
- Roadmap announcements and practical how-to guidance
